# 4Relief — For Relief Humanitarian Foundation

> 4Relief is an independent humanitarian organisation. This website presents its projects, areas of work, policies and official contact information.

## Current information
- Official website: https://forrelief.org/
- Official email: info@forrelief.org
- Reply time: within 24 hours; resolution may take longer.
- Website donation channels are not open yet. Launch and payment terms will be announced on the website.
- Company reference: FOR RELIEF LTD, company number 17306194. Consult the company record for registration details; company registration alone does not establish charitable accreditation.
